python3 - <<'PY'
import json, struct

data = open('/workspace/trunc.db','rb').read()
assert data[0] == 0x0d, 'not a table leaf page'
ncell = int.from_bytes(data[3:5], 'big')
cell_start = int.from_bytes(data[5:7], 'big')
print('page type', hex(data[0]), 'cells', ncell, 'content start', hex(cell_start))

def varint(buf, p):
    v = 0
    for i in range(9):
        b = buf[p+i]
        if i == 8:
            return (v << 8) | b, p+9
        v = (v << 7) | (b & 0x7f)
        if not (b & 0x80):
            return v, p+i+1
    raise ValueError

def decode_record(payload):
    hlen, p = varint(payload, 0)
    types = []
    q = p
    while q < hlen:
        t, q = varint(payload, q)
        types.append(t)
    body = hlen
    vals = []
    for t in types:
        if t == 0:
            vals.append(None)
        elif t == 1:
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[body:body+1], 'big', signed=True)); body += 1
        elif t == 2:
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[body:body+2], 'big', signed=True)); body += 2
        elif t == 3:
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[body:body+3], 'big', signed=True)); body += 3
        elif t == 4:
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[body:body+4], 'big', signed=True)); body += 4
        elif t == 5:
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[body:body+6], 'big', signed=True)); body += 6
        elif t == 6:
            vals.append(int.from_bytes(payload[body:body+8], 'big', signed=True)); body += 8
        elif t == 7:
            vals.append(struct.unpack('>d', payload[body:body+8])[0]); body += 8
        elif t == 8:
            vals.append(0)
        elif t == 9:
            vals.append(1)
        elif t >= 12:
            n = (t-12)//2
            raw = payload[body:body+n]; body += n
            vals.append(raw if t % 2 == 0 else raw.decode('utf-8'))
        else:
            raise ValueError(f'reserved serial type {t}')
    return vals

rows=[]
ptrs=[int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]
for ptr in ptrs:
    payload_len, p = varint(data, ptr)
    rowid, p = varint(data, p)
    payload = data[p:p+payload_len]
    vals = decode_record(payload)
    print(rowid, ptr, payload_len, vals)
    rows.append((rowid, vals))

# Pick text column as word, numeric column as value
out=[]
for rowid, vals in rows:
    word = next(v for v in vals if isinstance(v, str))
    value = next(v for v in vals if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool))
    out.append({'word': word, 'value': value})

with open('/workspace/recover.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
PY
echo '--- file ---'
cat /workspace/recover.json
EOF
